name: turnstile
description: Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection: Cloudflare's turnstile-spin setup skill, installed from GitHub at a pinned commit, plus server-side siteverify checks for /security and /verify.

detect.ask: Protect sign-up, login, OTP or other public forms from bots with Cloudflare Turnstile (a free CAPTCHA alternative; works on any host)? It adds Cloudflare's setup skill and server-side token checks to /security and /verify.

owner_tasks.task: When you first set up Turnstile: create a Cloudflare API token with the Account.Turnstile:Edit permission and export it as CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN in the terminal you start the agent from (never paste it into chat)
owner_tasks.why: the turnstile-spin skill creates the widget through Cloudflare's API

owner_tasks.task: Keep TURNSTILE_SECRET in the backend's secret store (a gitignored .env locally, the host's secret manager in production), and set TURNSTILE_HOSTNAMES to the production frontend hostnames
owner_tasks.why: the server checks every token with Cloudflare's siteverify using that secret

env.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET
env.purpose: Turnstile widget secret, used only by the backend's siteverify call
env.how_to_get: created by the turnstile-spin skill, or Cloudflare dashboard → Turnstile → the widget

env.name: TURNSTILE_HOSTNAMES
env.purpose: Frontend hostnames a token may come from; production must not include localhost

third_party.name: turnstile-spin
third_party.note: Cloudflare's official Turnstile setup skill (15 files, checked 2026-11-08). Its scripts call api.cloudflare.com with curl and never take the secret as an argument.
